import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int maxk = 31;
    static final int MOD = (int)(1e9 + 7);
    static int kb;
    static long[][][] A = new long[70][maxk][maxk];
    static long[][][] pre = new long[maxk][maxk];
    static long[][][] suf = new long[maxk][maxk];
    static long[][] ans = new long[maxk][maxk];
    static long[][] I = new long[maxk][maxk];
    static int[] dig = new int[70];
    static int len = 0;

    static void init_I() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= kb; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(I[i], 0);
            I[i][i] = 1;
        }
    }

    static void mat_mul(long[][] A_mat, long[][] B, long[][] res) {
        long[][] C = new long[kb+1][kb+1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= kb; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(C[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= kb; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= kb; k++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                    C[i][j] = (C[i][j] + A_mat[i][k] * B[k][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= kb; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(C[i], 0, res[i], 0, kb+1);
        }
    }

    static void prepocess() {
        // Initialize A[0]
        for (int i = 0; i < kb; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(A[0][i], 0);
            for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                A[0][i][j] = 0;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                A[0][i][j] = 0;
            }
            for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                // set A[0][i][j][j] and A[0][i][i][j] to 1
                A[0][i][j] = 1;
                A[0][i][i] = 1;
            }
        }
        // The above is an approximation; in C++, the nested loops set diagonal to 1 and also for same i, j.

        for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(pre[j], 0);
            }
            // Copy previous
            for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                System.arraycopy(A[i - 1][0], 0, pre[j], 0, kb+1);
            }
            // Build prefix
            for (int j = 1; j < kb; j++) {
                mat_mul(A[i - 1][j], pre[j - 1], pre[j]);
            }
            // Build suffix
            for (int j = 0; j <= kb; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(suf[j], 0);
            }
            System.arraycopy(A[i - 1][kb - 1], 0, suf[kb - 1], 0, kb+1);
            for (int j = kb - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                mat_mul(suf[j + 1], A[i - 1][j], suf[j]);
            }
            // Build A[i]
            for (int j = 0; j < kb; j++) {
                long[][] temp = new long[kb+1][kb+1];
                if (j > 0) {
                    mat_mul(pre[j - 1], suf[j], temp);
                } else {
                    // When j==0, use I
                    for (int x = 0; x <= kb; x++) {
                        System.arraycopy(I[x], 0, temp[x], 0, kb+1);
                    }
                    mat_mul(pre[j], suf[j], temp);
                }
                // Copy temp to A[i][j]
                for (int x = 0; x <= kb; x++) {
                    System.arraycopy(temp[x], 0, A[i][j], 0, kb+1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static class ScannerInput {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        public ScannerInput() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                String line = br.readLine();
                if (line == null) return -1;
                st = new StringTokenizer(line);
            }
            return Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return (int)nextLong();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        ScannerInput sc = new ScannerInput();

        long n = sc.nextLong();
        kb = sc.nextInt();

        init_I();

        while (n > 0) {
            dig[len++] = (int)(n % kb);
            n /= kb;
        }

        prepocess();

        // Initialize ans
        for (int i = 0; i <= kb; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(ans[i], 0);
        }
        ans[kb][0] = 1;

        int x = 0;
        for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int limit = dig[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < limit; j++) {
                long[][] temp = new long[kb+1][kb+1];
                mat_mul(A[i][(j + x) % kb], ans, temp);
                // Copy temp into ans
                for (int r = 0; r <= kb; r++) {
                    System.arraycopy(temp[r], 0, ans[r], 0, kb+1);
                }
            }
            x = (x + limit) % kb;
        }

        long res = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < kb; i++) {
            res = (res + ans[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(res + 1);
    }
}
